resources.string: Review and close interrupted file sharing

Your saved Factory policy controls this share. Only a verified private copy, up to 8 MiB, is shared. Choose a recipient in Android’s chooser. New read access lasts up to five minutes and can be revoked in Factory permissions. Recipient copies and already-open streams cannot be recalled. Jarvys never confirms delivery.
Checking the requesting app and complete file. No sharing has been authorized.
The recipient may still be reading after the chooser returns. The temporary read lease expires automatically. No delivery or recipient closure is confirmed.

This interaction was interrupted. Its outcome is unknown and it will not be replayed. Clear the interrupted operation to revoke new access and remove its private copy. Copies and already-open streams cannot be recalled.
This request is unavailable, expired or revoked. No delivery is confirmed. Review interrupted sharing here if needed.
